overview: This uint8 enum chooses which fighter-specific action and bone controller classes the game builds when a character is set up.

None.simple: The game uses the general fighter controller with no character-specific behavior.
None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_Character's constructor sets ActionControllerType to None. CreateActionController has no matching case, so the default branch builds UGameCharacterActionController and initializes it with base default actions. CreateBoneController similarly builds UGameCharacterBoneController. The exported CN_210 character row stores None.

CP_010.simple: This fighter gains extra strength as their cursed energy meter rises.
CP_010.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_010_ActionController for the CP_010 row. OnCursedEnergyLevelChanged removes CP_010_Passive at level 1, adds BUFF_CP_010_PASSIVE_2 at level 2 and BUFF_CP_010_PASSIVE_3 at levels 3 and 4. CreateAction falls through to the base implementation.

CP_020.simple: This fighter's super attack sends out a shockwave and their counter can heal them.
CP_020.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_020_ActionController for the CP_020 row. Its first normal attack counts non-projectile hits by other actors as its own and re-arms the homing Z. OnDamageDealt starts a shockwave for SuperCursedEnergyAttack rows and applies PendingHealAmount when IsCoercionCountReached is true. CreateAction supplies twelve character-specific normal, cursed-energy and extra attacks.

CP_030.simple: This fighter's summoned shikigami stays tracked between attacks.
CP_030.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_030_ActionController for the CP_030 row. OnShikigamiSummoned records the last active summoned shikigami as PendingShikigami. ResetCombatState clears the summon list and deactivates every shikigami. CreateAction adds auto versions of CursedEnergyAttack_2 in both stances.

CP_040.simple: This fighter's Hairpin and Resonance marks keep a passive boost alive.
CP_040.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_040_ActionController for the CP_040 row. ActionTick removes the Nobara passive once no opponent carries a Hairpin or Resonance stack. CanAcceptActionType blocks normal attacks while CursedEnergyAttack_2 runs on the attack layer. CreateAction overrides the first and second cursed-energy attacks and their auto variants.

CP_050.simple: This fighter can set up a domain expansion and absorb incoming hits.
CP_050.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_050_ActionController for the CP_050 row. The controller overrides PrepareCasterForDomainExpansion, SetHitAbsorbed and GetCursedEnergyDrainRate. Slot 252 places the owner beside the secondary target. CreateAction supplies custom jump, floating and attack actions.

CP_060.simple: This fighter's tension recovery depends on input and saved character data.
CP_060.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_060_ActionController for the CP_060 row. GetTensionRecoverRate returns 0.0 when input is disabled and otherwise reads GetCharacterUniqueFloatValue(3, 0). The controller overrides ShouldInterceptHit and IsCounterStateActive, which returns false, and has battle-start, gauge-level and knockout hooks. CreateAction replaces NormalAttack_1 and its air version.

CP_070.simple: This fighter chains a dash and third strike into an extra attack.
CP_070.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_070_ActionController for the CP_070 row. NormalAttack_3 queues an ExtraAttack_1 request. The controller overrides ApplyRevivalBuff and GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate and supplies custom dash, air homing and attack actions.

CP_080.simple: This fighter can survive one otherwise fatal sequence hit.
CP_080.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_080_ActionController for the CP_080 row. ShouldPreventLethalSequenceDamage checks bRevivalSpent. It overrides OnDownRecoveryStarted, ArmRevival and ApplyRevivalBuff and supplies a custom NormalAttack_2_1 and cursed-energy attacks.

CP_081.simple: This fighter holds super armor while taking a hit and levels up a passive.
CP_081.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_081_ActionController for the CP_081 row. This subclass of UCP_080_ActionController enables super armor while a damage-layer action is busy outside battle sequences. It changes ground and landing effects by cursed-energy level and activates a level-based passive buff. CreateAction adds ExtraAttack_1 and the ground and air CursedEnergyAttack_2.

CP_090.simple: This fighter plants an effect on the target during a special move.
CP_090.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_090_ActionController for the CP_090 row. ApplyPassiveLevel applies a cursed-energy level passive. The unique action aims from the owner's forward vector or a nearby secondary target, spawns FX_CP_090_00101 and attaches it under a mesh root. AdvanceUniqueEffect re-attaches it to the owner mesh and spawns FX_CP_090_00102. CreateAction replaces NormalAttack_2, NormalAttack_3 and CursedEnergyAttack_1.

CP_100.simple: This fighter finishes combos with a third hit and a beam.
CP_100.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_100_ActionController for the CP_100 row. Its third normal hit and first cursed-energy attack have custom actions. Those actions play FX_CP_100_00103 and the FX_CP_100_06101 beam. GetActionStaticData is overridden.

CP_110.simple: This fighter's passive stack calls in a shikigami follow-up.
CP_110.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_110_ActionController for the CP_110 row. A CP_110_Passive stack arms the shikigami follow-up and sets action flag 158. The controller overrides GetPassionGainRate and reacts to an ally knockout. CreateAction supplies custom normal and cursed-energy attacks.

CP_120.simple: This fighter sends a summoned shikigami into its own strike.
CP_120.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_120_ActionController for the CP_120 row. It sends shikigami 2 to Attack_1 beside the owner and raises flag 159 once that shikigami is summoned. CreateAction replaces the first and third normal attacks and CursedEnergyAttack_1.

CP_130.simple: This fighter's passive strikes follow a timed hit rhythm.
CP_130.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_130_ActionController for the CP_130 row. OnDamageDealt re-arms the receiver hit interval and counts non-projectile hits for passive bookkeeping. It overrides IsPassiveDamageRow and SetupPassives. CreateAction adds SuperCursedEnergyAttack and auto versions of CursedEnergyAttack_2.

CP_140.simple: This fighter fires a beam that grows while it drains cursed energy.
CP_140.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_140_ActionController for the CP_140 row. The beam phases drain cursed energy after BeamDuration, grow the beam at 10000 units per second up to 4000 units and clip it at the first contact hit. OnCursedEnergyLevelChanged applies the passive. CreateAction adds SuperCursedEnergyAttack.

CP_150.simple: This fighter uses traps and can switch appearance mid-fight.
CP_150.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_150_ActionController for the CP_150 row. It overrides OnTrapSpawned, OnTrapFinished and OnMaterialPatternChanged, and SetupPassives. CreateAction supplies custom normal attacks and cursed-energy attacks.

CP_160.simple: This fighter times shikigami follow-ups to a summon cooldown.
CP_160.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_160_ActionController for the CP_160 row. It overrides OnShikigamiSummonCooldownRestarted, GetCursedEnergyDrainRate and battle-sequence start and stop hooks. CreateAction adds CursedEnergyAttack_2 with auto and air variants.

CP_051.simple: This fighter's passive swaps their battle lines and strengthens a beam.
CP_051.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_051_ActionController for the CP_051 row. Its passive swaps the character voice group sets while it is applied and changes the passive beam damage rate. CreateAction supplies its own jump, floating, normal and cursed-energy attacks.

CP_121.simple: This fighter trades cursed energy recovery for a released shikigami.
CP_121.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_121_ActionController for the CP_121 row. GetCursedEnergyRecoveryWaitRate, GetCursedEnergyDrainRate and GetAttackCursedEnergyGainRate are overridden. ActionTick releases shikigami 1 when input is on and the shikigami is out. CreateAction supplies its own attack actions.

CP_200.simple: This fighter's number of air jumps comes from saved character data.
CP_200.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_200_ActionController for the CP_200 row. GetAirJumpLimit reads GetCharacterUniqueFloatValue(0, 0), clamps the result to at least 1.0 and casts it to int32. The controller also overrides GetActionCancelTable, OnCursedTechniqueNullified and OnKillCredit, and CreateAction adds ExtraAttack_1 and ExtraAttack_2.

CP_170.simple: This fighter aims carefully and has a special air finisher.
CP_170.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_170_ActionController for the CP_170 row. ActionTick processes aim-mode attack and cancellation input. CreateAction adds Guard, SuperCursedEnergyAttackAir and ExtraAttack_1. OnEffectPlayed is overridden.

CP_180.simple: This fighter's dash gauge fills back up over time.
CP_180.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_180_ActionController for the CP_180 row. GetDashGaugeRecoverInterpSpeed and GetDashGaugeRecoverWaitRate control dash gauge recovery. CreateAction replaces Idle, Run, dash, jump, guard-air and normal attacks. A passive stack selects which NormalAttack_1_1 attack set is used.

CP_190.simple: This fighter hides their weapon during a finishing move.
CP_190.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_190_ActionController for the CP_190 row. HideWeaponForFinish and ShowWeaponAfterFinish control the weapon around a finisher. The controller overrides SetupPassives and PrepareTargetForDomainExpansion. CreateAction supplies its normal and cursed-energy attacks.

CP_210.simple: This fighter charges attacks and has a strong parry.
CP_210.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_210_ActionController for the CP_210 row. ResolveActionHomingId maps the A, B and C first-hit ids to their _02 variants. It overrides SetupPassives and supplies JustGuard actions in CreateAction. Charge effects and nearby-character searches run in its action bodies.

CP_220.simple: This fighter's weak and strong passive stacks change their attacks.
CP_220.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_220_ActionController for the CP_220 row. SetupPassives uses Weak and Strong stacks to choose owner-unique index 1 or 2. The controller reacts to battle sequence start, knockout and buff changes. CreateAction supplies CursedEnergyAttack_1 from the shared base.

CP_230.simple: This fighter's beam attacks grow stronger with charge.
CP_230.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_230_ActionController for the CP_230 row. CreateAction adds character-specific normal, cursed-energy and super attacks. The second attack row advances with the charge stage and AttackDefault makes the beam burst. A CP_230_CursedEnergyAttack1 stack sets GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate to zero.

CP_240.simple: This fighter places a shikigami group using fixed offsets.
CP_240.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_240_ActionController for the CP_240 row. Passive buffs are selected by level and saved unique-float thresholds. Shikigami X, Y and Z offsets come from owner unique floats. The dash is suppressed during CursedEnergyAttack_1 and Air_1. CreateAction adds custom second and third normals.

CP_250.simple: This fighter's passive changes how some of their hits land.
CP_250.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_250_ActionController for the CP_250 row. It overrides IsPassiveDamageRow, OnAttackGuarded and OnDamageDealt. CreateAction adds SuperCursedEnergyAttack and custom second and third normal attacks.

CP_260.simple: This fighter tracks each projectile hit in a volley.
CP_260.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_260_ActionController for the CP_260 row. OnCollisionContact counts one hit per victim in a volley hit track. It overrides ModifyReceivedDamage, IsSuperArmorEnabled and ResolveFollowUpAttackType. CreateAction adds SuperCursedEnergyAttack.

CP_270.simple: This fighter's follow-up strike changes with a stack count.
CP_270.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCP_270_ActionController for the CP_270 row. ResolveAttackDamageId maps first-hit damage ids to per-stack _1.._4 variants while ProjectionSorceryCancelCount is positive. It overrides GetGuardDurabilityDamageRate and AllowsGuardRigidityAndKnockback. CreateAction supplies Guard and JustGuard actions.

CN_041.simple: This enemy has heavy armor, ignores stray hits and cannot be thrown.
CN_041.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_041_ActionController for the CN_041 row. IsArmorIgnoreResisted returns 1, hyper armor returns true when the base check passes or DownValue is positive, and ShouldIgnoreHit and CanHitDestructibleMeshes require bBattleSetupDone and no active battle sequence. Throw hits, tag combos, revival buffs and situation voices are refused. CreateAction supplies its own locomotion, attacks and super attack.

CN_060.simple: This enemy can jump twice and changes how dashes are cancelled.
CN_060.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_060_ActionController for the CN_060 row. GetAirJumpLimit returns 2. InitCharacterSpecificState removes DashJumpBegin from the NormalDash cancel list and adds RunJumpBegin, JumpAirBegin and RunJumpAirBegin to other cancel lists. CreateAction only overrides NormalAttack_1 and its air version.

CN_071.simple: This enemy fires a beam whose size follows the ground contact.
CN_071.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_071_ActionController for the CN_071 row. SetBeamWidth writes BeamWidthScale on Niagara components. SpawnBeamGroundEffect traces from 10000 units above a marker down to 10 units below it. Its cancel table removes Idle transitions. CreateAction supplies custom normals and cursed-energy attacks.

CN_081.simple: This enemy needs a full cursed energy bar to use its technique.
CN_081.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_081_ActionController for the CN_081 row. CanUseCursedEnergyTechnique requires full cursed energy unless bIgnoreGauge is set. CanAcceptActionType rejects Guard, GuardAir and NormalAttackAir_2. CanPlaySituationVoice accepts only index 1. UpdateBeamEffect returns -1.0f for an invalid effect.

CN_090.simple: This enemy leaves a burst effect at the waist after a homing dash.
CN_090.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_090_ActionController for the CN_090 row. OnHomingWarpEnd spawns FX_CP_000_01501 at the waist bone. CanUseCursedEnergyTechnique requires full cursed energy unless bIgnoreGauge is set. CreateAction supplies NormalAttack_3_1, cursed-energy attack 2 and super attacks.

CN_111.simple: This enemy has customized air attacks and jump cancels.
CN_111.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_111_ActionController for the CN_111 row. CreateAction replaces the ground and air second and third normal attacks. InitCharacterSpecificState removes DashJumpBegin from NormalDash cancels and adds RunJumpBegin. Its cancel table and tag, revival and voice hooks match the other restricted enemy controllers.

CN_120.simple: This enemy can extend jumps out of dashes and air movement.
CN_120.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_120_ActionController for the CN_120 row. GetAirJumpLimit returns 2. InitCharacterSpecificState adds JumpAirBegin and RunJumpAirBegin to the JumpAir cancel set and changes NormalDash cancels. CreateAction overrides the first and third normal attacks.

CN_122.simple: This enemy has its own dodge step and voice cues.
CN_122.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_122_ActionController for the CN_122 row. CreateAction adds Step and StepAir plus custom normal and cursed-energy attacks. The controller overrides PlayVoiceCue, OnDamageDealt and ActionTick and keeps its own state reset.

CN_130.simple: This enemy can jump twice in the air.
CN_130.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_130_ActionController for the CN_130 row. GetAirJumpLimit returns 2 and GetActionCancelTable exposes its own ActionCancelTable filled in slot 298. Tag combos, revival buffs and situation voices return false. The class declares no CreateAction override and its implementation file contains only includes.

CN_140.simple: This enemy keeps armor while its down gauge is positive and uses its own knockdown poses.
CN_140.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_140_ActionController for the CN_140 row. IsArmorIgnoreResisted returns 1, hyper armor returns true when the base check passes or DownValue is positive, and ShouldIgnoreHit requires bBattleSetupDone and no active battle sequence. CreateAction adds its own Down and DownEnd actions plus custom normals and cursed-energy attacks. Tag combos, revival buffs and situation voices return false.

CN_150.simple: This enemy refuses most evasive actions.
CN_150.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_150_ActionController for the CN_150 row. CanAcceptActionType rejects most dash, guard, step and air attack requests. CreateAction only replaces NormalAttack_1 and NormalAttack_2. Tag combos, revival buffs and situation voices return false.

CN_160.simple: This enemy has one signature normal attack and strict action rules.
CN_160.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_160_ActionController for the CN_160 row. CreateAction only replaces NormalAttack_3. CanAcceptActionType rejects dash, guard, step and several air attacks. InitCharacterSpecificState edits the cancel table in the same way as CN_120.

CN_170.simple: This enemy changes appearance when a certain action starts.
CN_170.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_170_ActionController for the CN_170 row. OnActionStarted calls SetMaterialPattern(1) when the next action requests a start material pattern. CanApplyRevivalBuff returns false and the class has no CreateAction override.

CN_230.simple: This enemy's beam attacks grow with its charge and passive.
CN_230.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_230_ActionController for the CN_230 row. CreateAction adds character-specific normal, cursed-energy and super attacks. The second attack row advances with charge stage and AttackDefault makes the beam burst. SetupPassives adds the CN_230 passive buff and dims the gradation decal by 0.1 per passive stack.

CN_240.simple: This enemy's special attack only works on cursed spirits.
CN_240.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_240_ActionController for the CN_240 row. Slot 103 makes CN_240_ATTACKI_01_01 do nothing to characters outside the CursedSpirits group. CreateAction adds custom Idle, normal, damage, extra and super attacks. The controller also overrides ModifyReceivedDamage and TransferAdaptDamage.

CN_250.simple: This enemy reacts when its guard breaks.
CN_250.technical: CreateActionController constructs UCN_250_ActionController for the CN_250 row. OnGuardBroken and OnHitPointChanged feed its state, and GetActionCancelTable returns a custom table. CreateAction adds custom first normal and cursed-energy attacks and super attacks.

Invalid.simple: An out-of-range marker that falls back to the general fighter controller.
Invalid.technical: The header places Invalid outside the contiguous member range. CreateActionController's documented jump table covers Type - 1 over 0x2D, and out-of-range values reach the default branch that builds UGameCharacterActionController. No exported character row uses Invalid.

notes: The numeric order follows declaration order. CP_051, CP_121 and CP_200 are declared after CP_160, and CP_170 through CP_270 are declared after CP_200.
Every named controller member has its own case in CreateActionController. None and Invalid reach the default branch.
The exported CN_260 character row uses CP_160, and the exported CN_210 character row uses None.
Only CN_041, CN_060, CN_071, CN_081, CN_120, CN_130, CN_140 and CN_150 have dedicated bone controller cases. Other members use the base bone controller.
Status reflects a traced factory case or default branch. The player-facing meaning of the CP and CN codes is not spelled out in the enum header.
